root_idea.summary: The root centers on hunger: the painful state caused by an empty stomach, opposed to satiety.
root_idea.development: The basic bodily condition extends in Classical Arabic to periods of widespread hunger or famine and to derived expressions for causing, deliberately undertaking, displaying, or figuratively desiring through hunger.

senses.definition: To be or become hungry; to have an empty belly.
senses.usage_conditions: An active Form I verb expressing the condition opposed to satiety.

senses.definition: Hunger: the painful condition caused by an empty stomach, or emptiness of the belly.
senses.usage_conditions: A bodily state opposed to satiety; the Quranic noun denotes hunger itself rather than the separately derived sense of a famine period.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire or long for someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction with إِلَى, including longing to meet someone or longing for someone's property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone to become hungry or empty-bellied; to deprive someone of food and drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Causative Form II and Form IV usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To constrain a dependent or ignoble person through want so that he has recourse to, or remains attached to, one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension illustrated in the proverb about making a dog hungry so that it follows.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make oneself hungry or empty-bellied intentionally; to abstain from eating fully.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form V; may describe deliberate dietary restriction, including restriction undertaken for taking medicine.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To show or present oneself as hungry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form X usage concerning the outward display of hunger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Insatiability or an unceasing appetite for knowledge.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction with knowledge as the object of the appetite.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A period or year of famine and widespread hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The derived noun may designate a time of drought or collective deprivation, as in a famine year.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Nursing that satisfies an infant's hunger and thereby constitutes the legally consequential form of suckling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical legal expression distinguishing hunger-satisfying nursing in infancy from nursing after hunger is satisfied only by solid food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An imprecatory formula invoking hunger upon someone.
A single temporary attack or episode of hunger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The feminine noun marks one occurrence or bout of the condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A condition of destitution and hunger affecting a tribe.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective use referring to a tribe's state rather than to one individual's temporary hunger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hungry or empty-bellied; also deprived of food and drink.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing a person or other subject in the state of hunger or food deprivation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a cooking pot that is not full.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative phrase describing scarcity of prepared food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Slender in the waist or belly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression applied to a woman; the bodily comparison does not restrict the ordinary adjective's reference.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The space or distance at which a satiated person becomes hungry.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distance measure defined by the point at which hunger would arise in one who is presently satisfied with food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who habitually appears hungry, or who is continually eating one thing after another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The explanations describe a persistent appearance or recurrent eating behavior.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Causative hunger and figurative coercion through want.

Habitual appearance of hunger or continual eating.

cautions: The Quranic evidence attests the basic hunger noun and Form I verb; the derived famine noun مَجَاعَةٌ is preserved separately as a broader Classical Arabic meaning rather than merged into the Quranic noun sense.
